description: The Philips 10000mAh 22.5W Max Fast Charging Power Bank is designed for powerful, efficient, and reliable charging. Featuring a high-performance lithium polymer battery and triple output ports (2 Type-C + 1 USB-A), it allows you to charge multiple devices simultaneously. The smart digital LED display keeps you informed about the remaining battery percentage, while the compact and lightweight design makes it ideal for travel, office, and everyday use. Compatible with smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and other USB-powered devices, this power bank ensures you stay connected anytime, anywhere.
